chunks: Al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd narrated from al-Qāsim ibn Sulaymān, from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
He asked him about a boy being married to a girl: do they inherit from one another? He said: “If it was their parents who married them, then yes.”
ai.seo_question: Do two minor children who are married inherit from one another in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the inheritance of two minors who were married. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام states that mutual inheritance applies when the marriage was arranged by their respective parents.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5663 - Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd narrated from Al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:

He asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a boy being married to a girl - do they inherit from one another?
Imam (as) said: "If it was their parents who arranged their marriage, then yes, they do inherit from each other."
